uncited: These methods rely on spatial data structures, typically octrees, to refine resolution near the surface.
The core mechanism involves traversing an octree to identify regions where the implicit field $f(\mathbf{x}) = 0$ intersects the volume.
This family of methods is widely used in computer graphics for extracting surfaces from volumetric data or neural implicit representations.
